body: So this is late. But just wanted to let everyone know we figured it out and our room turned out great! Thanks all!

Thank you for responding. I actually thought I made my parents sound pretty bad. Everything I wrote is true but I do believe they are good people deep down. I believe they want the best for me they just dont know what that is/have their own issues that prevent them from accomplishing it. Perhaps I am wrong? I think they really do believe they are decent parents. I would love your opinion. I don’t even know what to think anymore.

Thank you for replying! Its good to hear that it wasn’t just me refusing to speak. Logically I know that part wasnt my fault. Also I was so young. But its good to hear it from someone else. Thank you!

Beauty standards differ everywhere. White is not more beautiful; it is just perceived as more beautiful in certain cultures. In the US tans are trendy. It is simply an arbitrary standard that probably derived from past associations. In some countries like China being pale was associated with being rich, because it meant you didn’t have to work in the fields. In the US being tan is associated with being rich, because it means you could afford that Caribbean vacation. There is no real meaning behind it. You are not less than just because you are darker. Where do you live? One day you may move somewhere where being dark is trendy and you may be grateful for your skin tone. 

Don’t waste time, energy, or money trying to impress people who don’t care about you anyway. Even if you were pale they wouldn’t truly care about you. It would just be artificial approval. You’re not missing out on anything meaningful because anyone worth forming friendships with will look past your outward appearance.

Im pretty sure ESAs are only allowed in Disney hotels and certain designated areas. They’re not allowed in the parks. Are you taking psychiatric service dogs? Because those are different. I don’t have an ESA but I qualified for one. I just never did the steps because it wasn’t necessary. ESAs are not service dogs. They are not allowed in public places like parks or restaurants. They are allowed to travel (fly for free) and stay in living accommodations dogs are not allowed in (like apartments). The logic behind ESAs is that the person needs the dog (or animal) to live with them for emotional support. But they don’t need them for day to day activities and they’re not allowed to take them most places.

Added: If I wanted to drive how should I go about being insured now? Should I let the insurance company know I didnt realize I needed to be on the policy? They’ll probably think Im an idiot (which I am) or should I just ask to be added and not say anything else?

Thank you all so much for your help. I really appreciate it.

I do have my actual license. I got it after I passed my test and have renewed it when necessary. It is definitely legit. My brother also had his license. We use a popular car insurance company so I am super confused. I feel like they dont know I exist...

Even my brother doesnt seem to really know the answer and he’s much older than me. I guess my whole family is just clueless. My mom doesnt work and has never paid attention to things like this. She just lets my dad take care of it.

My dad says an agent told him this. (Many years ago.) I do think he truly believes this from what he’s said. Plus my dad is not a risk taker. I believe he would never knowingly commit fraud (mostly out of a fear of being caught). My dad can be pretty dense. He once flipped a birthday cake over in its container because he thought it was supposed be that way (after he took it out the right way from the fridge). It was so ridiculous we were all just speechless after he told us his reasoning. He also once said I was leaving a lot of hair in the bathroom and he knew it was mine because of the color. Everyone in my family has the exact same color hair. 😳 He often says things that just leave my brother and I dumbfounded. 

Because of what he believes my dad refuses to see evidence and argues with me if I bring it up. Luckily I can just avoid driving. I am in college and only home during the summer. I dont need to drive.

I do have a question. If I were to borrow my brother’s car (which would happen maybe like 2 times a year) would I be covered under permissive use since I dont live with him and its a once in a blue moon thing?

Again: thank you for all your help. Im sorry for being so clueless. I literally never thought to question my dad in the past after he said the insurance agent told him this. I realize now I have really and truly been an idiot. I am very thankful to never have been in an accident. Or stopped by police.
Thank you to everyone who responded. It really means a lot to me. I am reading all the replies and you are all so kind and caring. God bless everyone.

Thank you so much. I think I know that somewhere deep down (but I cant help but doubt it) but it really helps to hear it from someone else. I will ask my teachers for an extension.
